ailang_1501_risk_for_T4: HIGH. Quadratic cons/foldl: gcns scan of 331k rows takes ~8 min, medium (50k out) ~9 min. The large tier encodes and hashes all 331k rows, so encodeRows, count, checkRow and sidecar paths scale quadratically and will likely take tens of minutes or hours. T4 needs linear accumulation (chunked/array build) or an upstream fix before large is practical, and make test must not depend on it. The strict-VM core stays pure, so the fix is local to the accumulators.
